name: Toi-Gye
meaning: The pen name of the 16th-century scholar Yi Hwang, a leading authority on neo-Confucianism. The 37 movements refer to the 37 degrees latitude of his birthplace, and the diagram represents a scholar.
endingPosition: Bring the right foot back to a ready posture
diagram: Floor diagram image shaped to represent a 'scholar', with points A to F and diagonals such as BD, AD and CE.
